From e3f9bed9bee261e3347131764e42aeedf1ffea61 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Kuniyuki Iwashima <kuniyu@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2024 17:55:15 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] llc: Drop support for ETH_P_TR_802_2.

syzbot reported an uninit-value bug below. [0]

llc supports ETH_P_802_2 (0x0004) and used to support ETH_P_TR_802_2
(0x0011), and syzbot abused the latter to trigger the bug.

  write$tun(r0, &(0x7f0000000040)={@val={0x0, 0x11}, @val, @mpls={[], @llc={@snap={0xaa, 0x1, ')', "90e5dd"}}}}, 0x16)

llc_conn_handler() initialises local variables {saddr,daddr}.mac
based on skb in llc_pdu_decode_sa()/llc_pdu_decode_da() and passes
them to __llc_lookup().

However, the initialisation is done only when skb->protocol is
htons(ETH_P_802_2), otherwise, __llc_lookup_established() and
__llc_lookup_listener() will read garbage.

The missing initialisation existed prior to commit 211ed865108e
("net: delete all instances of special processing for token ring").

It removed the part to kick out the token ring stuff but forgot to
close the door allowing ETH_P_TR_802_2 packets to sneak into llc_rcv().

Let's remove llc_tr_packet_type and complete the deprecation.

diff --git a/include/net/llc_pdu.h b/include/net/llc_pdu.h
index 7e73f8e5e497..1d55ba7c45be 100644
--- a/include/net/llc_pdu.h
+++ b/include/net/llc_pdu.h
@@ -262,8 +262,7 @@ static inline void llc_pdu_header_init(struct sk_buff *skb, u8 type,
  */
 static inline void llc_pdu_decode_sa(struct sk_buff *skb, u8 *sa)
 {
-	if (skb->protocol == htons(ETH_P_802_2))
-		memcpy(sa, eth_hdr(skb)->h_source, ETH_ALEN);
+	memcpy(sa, eth_hdr(skb)->h_source, ETH_ALEN);
 }
 
 /**
@@ -275,8 +274,7 @@ static inline void llc_pdu_decode_sa(struct sk_buff *skb, u8 *sa)
  */
 static inline void llc_pdu_decode_da(struct sk_buff *skb, u8 *da)
 {
-	if (skb->protocol == htons(ETH_P_802_2))
-		memcpy(da, eth_hdr(skb)->h_dest, ETH_ALEN);
+	memcpy(da, eth_hdr(skb)->h_dest, ETH_ALEN);
 }
 
 /**

diff --git a/net/llc/llc_core.c b/net/llc/llc_core.c
index 6e387aadffce..4f16d9c88350 100644
--- a/net/llc/llc_core.c
+++ b/net/llc/llc_core.c
@@ -135,22 +135,15 @@ static struct packet_type llc_packet_type __read_mostly = {
 	.func = llc_rcv,
 };
 
-static struct packet_type llc_tr_packet_type __read_mostly = {
-	.type = cpu_to_be16(ETH_P_TR_802_2),
-	.func = llc_rcv,
-};
-
 static int __init llc_init(void)
 {
 	dev_add_pack(&llc_packet_type);
-	dev_add_pack(&llc_tr_packet_type);
 	return 0;
 }
 
 static void __exit llc_exit(void)
 {
 	dev_remove_pack(&llc_packet_type);
-	dev_remove_pack(&llc_tr_packet_type);
 }
 
 module_init(llc_init);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `include/net/llc_pdu.h`**
   - The conditional checks for the Ethernet protocol type `ETH_P_802_2` in the functions `llc_pdu_decode_sa` and `llc_pdu_decode_da` have been removed. 
   - The `memcpy` operations for copying source and destination addresses now occur unconditionally, meaning they will execute regardless of the protocol type.

2. **File: `net/llc/llc_core.c`**
   - The `llc_tr_packet_type` structure, which was used to handle packets of type `ETH_P_TR_802_2`, has been removed entirely.
   - The initialization and removal of the `llc_tr_packet_type` from the packet processing system have been eliminated from the `llc_init` and `llc_exit` functions, respectively.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in `include/net/llc_pdu.h` and `net/llc/llc_core.c` are related in that they both address the handling of the deprecated `ETH_P_TR_802_2` protocol. By removing the `llc_tr_packet_type`, the code no longer supports this protocol, which was identified as a source of uninitialized value bugs. The unconditional copying of source and destination addresses in the PDU decoding functions ensures that the code does not rely on the protocol type for these operations, thus preventing potential garbage value issues when handling packets that were previously associated with `ETH_P_TR_802_2`. Overall, these changes complete the deprecation of support for the Token Ring protocol in the LLC layer.
